---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
# params only exists during knit; running chunks by hand needs this fallback
if (!exists("params") || !is.list(params))
  params <- list(gene = "RAC1", cell_line = "231", top_n = 15, gene_top_n = 10,
                 rank_from = "eif33d_promotes_hypoxia_1hr_lfc0.5_tcoreg_corrected_both_clipaggregate_yraw",
                 out_tag = "", model_desc = "TE regression forest",
                 save_plots = TRUE)
```

# Purpose

Where does one gene sit, feature by feature, relative to every other transcript in a cell
line's feature matrix? One row per feature on a shared 0-100 percentile scale, so lengths in
nucleotides, GC in percent and accessibility on 0-1 can share one axis. The gene's value is
printed beside each row.

- **Which features:** the `top_n` features with the largest mean |SHAP| in an MDA-MB-231 si3d
  hypoxia 1hr TE regression forest (`rank_from`, SHAP from `11_shap_regression.Rmd`). The
  default model has intrinsic and external features; `rank_from` can point at another, such as
  the intrinsic-only forest, with `out_tag` set so its outputs get their own filenames. The same
  list is used for both cell lines.
- **Background:** every transcript in the chosen cell line's feature matrix, each on that cell
  line's own dominant isoform (`feature_matrix_tco.rds` for MDA-MB-231,
  `feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds` for MCF7-SIX1).
- **Percentile** is mid-rank: the share of transcripts below the gene's value plus half the share
  tied with it, so a value shared by many transcripts lands in the middle of that tie rather
  than at its top.
- **Descriptive only.** This shows where the gene sits, not how the model used those values for
  this gene; that needs the gene's own SHAP values.

```{r libs}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(treeshap)

O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
GENE <- params$gene
CELL <- params$cell_line
stopifnot("cell_line must be 231 or mcf7six1" = CELL %in% c("231", "mcf7six1"))
CELL_LABEL <- c("231" = "MDA-MB-231", mcf7six1 = "MCF7-SIX1")[[CELL]]
DEFAULT_RANK_FROM <- "eif33d_promotes_hypoxia_1hr_lfc0.5_tcoreg_corrected_both_clipaggregate_yraw"
stopifnot("out_tag is required when rank_from is not the default model - outputs would overwrite it" =
            params$rank_from == DEFAULT_RANK_FROM || nzchar(params$out_tag))
OUT_STEM   <- paste0("35_gene_feature_percentiles", if (nzchar(params$out_tag)) paste0("_", params$out_tag))
MODEL_DESC <- params$model_desc
# Figure height for n feature rows: 5.5 in at the default 15, so default figures keep their size
fig_h <- function(n) 1.6 + 0.26 * n
GENE_COL <- "#0072B2"   # Okabe-Ito dark blue; orange / sky blue are reserved for si3d / si3e
TARGET_COL <- "#009E73" # Okabe-Ito bluish green: eIF3d target interquartile band
```

# Load

```{r load}
mat_file <- c("231" = "feature_matrix_tco.rds", mcf7six1 = "feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds")[[CELL]]
fm <- readRDS(file.path(O, mat_file))

shap_file  <- file.path(O, paste0("shapreg_feature_", params$rank_from, ".csv"))
model_file <- file.path(O, paste0("rfreg_model_", params$rank_from, ".rds"))
shap <- read_csv(shap_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

top <- shap %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_shap)) %>%
  slice_head(n = params$top_n) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(rank, feature, family, block, mean_abs_shap, share_pct)

# eIF3d targets in this cell line (TE promoted by eIF3d, hypoxia 1hr, lfc > 0.5)
target_file <- here("output", "genesets",
                    c("231" = "hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv",
                      mcf7six1 = "mcf7six1_hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv")[[CELL]])
targets <- read_csv(target_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
is_target <- fm$gene_id_clean %in% targets$ensembl_gene
```

# Checks

```{r checks}
stopifnot(
  # SHAP written before the model was last refit would explain a different forest
  "SHAP output predates the model it ranks - re-render 11_shap_regression.Rmd" =
    file.mtime(shap_file) >= file.mtime(model_file),
  "SHAP ranks are not 1..n in mean |SHAP| order" =
    identical(as.integer(shap$rank_shap[order(-shap$mean_abs_shap)]), seq_len(nrow(shap))),
  "fewer features than top_n" = nrow(top) == params$top_n,
  "a top feature is missing from the feature matrix" = all(top$feature %in% names(fm)),
  "gene missing from the feature matrix" = GENE %in% fm$symbol,
  "gene has more than one transcript in the matrix" = sum(fm$symbol == GENE, na.rm = TRUE) == 1,
  "target set has no ensembl_gene column" = "ensembl_gene" %in% names(targets),
  # gene-keyed set against a transcript-keyed matrix: one transcript per gene, so no double counting
  "a target gene has more than one transcript in the matrix" =
    !anyDuplicated(fm$gene_id_clean[is_target]),
  "fewer than half the target set is in the feature matrix" = sum(is_target) > 0.5 * nrow(targets)
)
cat("eIF3d targets:", nrow(targets), "in set,", sum(is_target), "in the", CELL_LABEL, "feature matrix\n")

# Internal consistency: each log2 length must be log2(raw length + 1), its definition in
# predictive_modeling/01_feature_extraction.Rmd, for every transcript
for (r in c("utr5", "cds", "utr3", "total")) {
  dev <- max(abs(fm[[paste0("log2_", r, "_length")]] - log2(fm[[paste0(r, "_length")]] + 1)), na.rm = TRUE)
  stopifnot("log2 length is not log2(raw length + 1)" = dev < 1e-9)
}

# Outside the matrix: CDS length must equal (protein length + stop) x 3, protein lengths from
# UniProt (RAC1 P63000, PFN1 P07737). Only genes listed here are checked.
uniprot_aa <- c(RAC1 = 192, PFN1 = 140)
g <- fm %>% filter(symbol == GENE)
if (GENE %in% names(uniprot_aa)) {
  cat(GENE, g$transcript_id_clean, "CDS", g$cds_length, "nt; UniProt", uniprot_aa[[GENE]], "aa\n")
  stopifnot("CDS length does not match the UniProt protein length" =
              g$cds_length == (uniprot_aa[[GENE]] + 1) * 3)
}
```

# Percentiles

```{r percentiles}
pct_of <- function(x, v) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (is.na(v)) return(NA_real_)
  100 * (sum(x < v) + 0.5 * sum(x == v)) / length(x)
}

# Every transcript's mid-rank percentile in one pass: average rank r = (n below) + (n tied + 1)/2,
# so 100 * (r - 0.5) / n is the same quantity pct_of() computes for a single value
pct_all <- function(x) 100 * (rank(x, ties.method = "average", na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(x))

# Targets' own percentiles against the same background
tgt_pct_of <- function(f) { p <- pct_all(fm[[f]])[is_target]; p[!is.na(p)] }

# The gene's value and percentile on each feature, plus the targets' centre (median: where do
# targets sit?) and spread (quartiles: is the gene target-like?). Used for both feature lists.
summarise_features <- function(tbl) {
  tbl %>%
    mutate(n_tx       = map_int(feature, ~ sum(!is.na(fm[[.x]]))),
           median     = map_dbl(feature, ~ median(fm[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE)),
           value      = map_dbl(feature, ~ g[[.x]]),
           pct        = map2_dbl(feature, value, ~ pct_of(fm[[.x]], .y)),
           symbol = GENE, transcript_id_clean = g$transcript_id_clean,
           tgt_n      = map_int(feature, ~ length(tgt_pct_of(.x))),
           tgt_q25    = map_dbl(feature, ~ quantile(tgt_pct_of(.x), 0.25)),
           tgt_median = map_dbl(feature, ~ median(tgt_pct_of(.x))),
           tgt_q75    = map_dbl(feature, ~ quantile(tgt_pct_of(.x), 0.75)))
}

check_features <- function(tbl) {
  stopifnot("percentile outside 0-100" = all(between(tbl$pct, 0, 100), na.rm = TRUE),
            "pct_all disagrees with pct_of for the gene" =
              all(abs(map_dbl(tbl$feature, ~ pct_all(fm[[.x]])[fm$symbol %in% GENE]) - tbl$pct) < 1e-9,
                  na.rm = TRUE),
            "target quartiles outside 0-100, or median not between them" =
              all(between(tbl$tgt_q25, 0, 100) & tbl$tgt_q25 <= tbl$tgt_median &
                  tbl$tgt_median <= tbl$tgt_q75))
  invisible(tbl)
}

res <- check_features(summarise_features(top))

# A random draw of n transcripts has median percentile ~ 50 +/- 100 * 0.5 / sqrt(n), the
# reference scale for how far a target median sits from the middle
cat("Null sd of the median percentile for", sum(is_target), "random transcripts:",
    round(100 * 0.5 / sqrt(sum(is_target)), 2), "points\n")
cat("Values not measured for", GENE, ":", sum(is.na(res$value)), "\n")

knitr::kable(res %>% dplyr::select(rank, feature, family, mean_abs_shap, value, pct, median, n_tx),
             digits = c(0, 0, 0, 4, 3, 1, 3, 0),
             caption = paste0(GENE, ": top ", params$top_n, " features by mean |SHAP| (MDA-MB-231 model), ",
                              "percentile among ", CELL_LABEL, " transcripts"))

if (params$save_plots) {
  out_csv <- file.path(O, sprintf("%s_%s_%s.csv", OUT_STEM, CELL, GENE))
  write_csv(res, out_csv)
  cat("Saved", out_csv, "\n")
}
```

# Figure

```{r figure, fig.width = 9, fig.height = fig_h(params$top_n)}
fmt <- function(f, v) {
  case_when(is.na(v) ~ "not measured",
            # log2 lengths read more easily with the nucleotide count beside them; formatC, not
            # format: format() picks one style for the whole vector and goes scientific
            str_detect(f, "^log2_.*_length$") ~ sprintf("%.2f (%s nt)", v, formatC(round(2^v - 1), format = "d", big.mark = ",")),
            abs(v) >= 100 ~ formatC(round(v), format = "d", big.mark = ","),
            TRUE ~ as.character(signif(v, 3)))
}
VAL_X <- 108

# Row 1 at the top
make_plot_df <- function(tbl) tbl %>% mutate(y = rev(seq_len(n()))[rank], txt = fmt(feature, value))

base_plot <- function(plot_df, title, subtitle) {
  ggplot(plot_df) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = 100, y = y, yend = y), colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = plot_df %>% crossing(q = c(25, 75)), aes(x = q, y = y),
               shape = 124, size = 2.5, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(aes(x = 50, y = y), shape = 124, size = 3.5, colour = "grey30") +
    geom_point(data = plot_df %>% filter(!is.na(pct)), aes(x = pct, y = y), colour = GENE_COL, size = 3) +
    geom_text(aes(x = VAL_X, y = y, label = txt), colour = GENE_COL, size = 3.2, hjust = 0) +
    annotate("text", x = VAL_X, y = nrow(plot_df) + 0.9, label = "Value", size = 3.4,
             hjust = 0, fontface = "bold") +
    # the axis line spans the 0-100 scale only, not the value column to its right
    annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = 100, y = -Inf, yend = -Inf, linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = plot_df$y, labels = plot_df$feature, expand = expansion(add = c(0.6, 1.4))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), limits = c(-1, VAL_X + 28),
                       expand = expansion(add = c(0, 0))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(x = paste0("Percentile among ", CELL_LABEL, " transcripts"), y = NULL,
         title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
          plot.title.position = "plot",   # align with the feature labels so the title is not clipped
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
          plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))
}

model_title <- paste0(GENE, ": top features for eIF3d regulation in hypoxia, ", CELL_LABEL, " transcriptome")
model_sub   <- paste0("Top ", params$top_n, " features by SHAP importance in the MDA-MB-231 ",
                      "si3d hypoxia 1hr ", MODEL_DESC, ".")
plot_df <- make_plot_df(res)
p <- base_plot(plot_df, model_title, model_sub)
p

if (params$save_plots) {
  out <- here("plots", sprintf("%s_%s_%s.pdf", OUT_STEM, CELL, GENE))
  ggsave(out, p, width = 9, height = fig_h(params$top_n))
  cat("Saved", out, "\n")
}
```

# Figure with the eIF3d target median

The green tick is the eIF3d target median, on the same transcriptome percentile scale as the
gene: where targets sit as a group. Random draws of the same size have a median at
50 +/- ~1.3 points, so a median well off the grey 50 tick means targets are shifted on that
feature.

This is the targets' centre, not their spread. Their 25th-75th percentile range spans 40-54
points (60 for the tied CLIP count), against exactly 50 for the transcriptome, so a gene off
the median can still be a typical target; the quartiles are in the results CSV
(`tgt_q25` / `tgt_q75`).

```{r figure-target-median, fig.width = 9, fig.height = fig_h(params$top_n)}
# base_plot's layers are, in order: grey line, 25/75 ticks, 50 tick, gene point, value text,
# header, axis. Target layers go above the grey line and ticks but below the gene point; the
# spread bar is translucent so the grey line shows through.
add_target_layers <- function(p, plot_df, spread) {
  stopifnot("base_plot's layer order changed - update the insertion point" =
              inherits(p$layers[[4]]$geom, "GeomPoint") && inherits(p$layers[[5]]$geom, "GeomText"))
  new <- list(geom_segment(data = plot_df,
                           aes(x = tgt_median, xend = tgt_median, y = y - 0.3, yend = y + 0.3),
                           colour = TARGET_COL, linewidth = 0.9))
  if (spread)
    new <- c(list(geom_rect(data = plot_df,
                            aes(xmin = tgt_q25, xmax = tgt_q75, ymin = y - 0.16, ymax = y + 0.16),
                            fill = TARGET_COL, alpha = 0.25)), new)
  p$layers <- c(p$layers[1:3], new, p$layers[-(1:3)])
  p
}

p_median <- add_target_layers(p, plot_df, spread = FALSE) +
  labs(subtitle = paste0(model_sub, "\nGreen tick: median of ", CELL_LABEL,
                         " eIF3d targets (n = ", sum(is_target), ")."))
p_median

if (params$save_plots) {
  out <- here("plots", sprintf("%s_targetmedian_%s_%s.pdf", OUT_STEM, CELL, GENE))
  ggsave(out, p_median, width = 9, height = fig_h(params$top_n))
  cat("Saved", out, "\n")
}
```

# Figure with the eIF3d target median and spread

The same median tick, plus a faded green bar from the 25th to the 75th percentile of eIF3d
targets: their spread. A gene inside the bar is target-like on that feature. If targets were a
random draw from the transcriptome, the bar would sit on the grey 25/75 ticks.

```{r figure-target-spread, fig.width = 9, fig.height = fig_h(params$top_n)}
spread_sub <- paste0(model_sub, "\nGreen: ", CELL_LABEL, " eIF3d targets (n = ", sum(is_target),
                     "); tick = median, bar = 25th-75th percentile.")
p_spread <- add_target_layers(p, plot_df, spread = TRUE) + labs(subtitle = spread_sub)
p_spread

if (params$save_plots) {
  out <- here("plots", sprintf("%s_targetspread_%s_%s.pdf", OUT_STEM, CELL, GENE))
  ggsave(out, p_spread, width = 9, height = fig_h(params$top_n))
  cat("Saved", out, "\n")
}
```

# Features ranked by the gene's own SHAP

The figures above use the model's overall top features, the same list for every gene. This one
picks the `gene_top_n` features with the largest |SHAP| **for this gene**, from all modelled
features, and orders the rows by it: the features that moved this gene's prediction most. The
SHAP values set the order only; the plot itself is the median-and-spread figure.

- **In-sample when the gene was a training gene.** SHAP is exact for the forest's prediction
  for this gene, but if the forest was fit on the gene, that prediction is pulled toward the
  gene's true TE change, so the ranking partly reflects what the forest learned about the gene
  itself. The split is printed below and stated in the subtitle.
- **SHAP always comes from the MDA-MB-231 model and that cell line's isoform**, whichever
  `cell_line` sets the percentile background.

```{r gene-shap}
rf <- readRDS(model_file)
md <- readRDS(file.path(O, paste0("rfreg_model_data_", params$rank_from, ".rds")))
stopifnot("the saved model data does not belong to rank_from's model" =
            identical(md$suffix, params$rank_from),
          "this is not a regression forest - treeshap cannot explain a probability forest" =
            rf$treetype == "Regression")
feature_cols <- md$feature_cols

gene_row <- bind_rows(md$train %>% mutate(split = "train"), md$test %>% mutate(split = "test")) %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean == g$gene_id_clean)
stopifnot("gene is not in the model's data, or is in it more than once" = nrow(gene_row) == 1)

# Exact TreeSHAP on the saved forest, as in 11_shap_regression.Rmd. Column order re-imposed:
# treeshap returns $shaps in its own order.
unified  <- ranger.unify(rf, as.data.frame(md$train[, feature_cols]))
gene_x   <- as.data.frame(gene_row)[, feature_cols]
gene_sv  <- treeshap(unified, gene_x, interactions = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)$shaps[, feature_cols]
pred     <- predict(rf, data = gene_x)$predictions
baseline <- mean(predict(rf, data = as.data.frame(md$train[, feature_cols]))$predictions)
cat(sprintf("%s: %s gene | TE change %.3f | forest prediction %.3f | baseline %.3f | sum of SHAP %.3f\n",
            GENE, gene_row$split, gene_row$y, pred, baseline, sum(gene_sv)))
stopifnot("SHAP does not add up to the forest's prediction for this gene" =
            abs(pred - sum(gene_sv) - baseline) < 1e-6)

gene_top <- tibble(feature = feature_cols, shap = as.numeric(gene_sv[1, ])) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(shap))) %>%
  slice_head(n = params$gene_top_n) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())
stopifnot("a feature is missing from the feature matrix" = all(gene_top$feature %in% names(fm)))

gene_res <- check_features(summarise_features(gene_top))
cat("Also in the model-wide top", params$top_n, ":", sum(gene_top$feature %in% top$feature),
    "of", params$gene_top_n, "\n")
knitr::kable(gene_res %>% dplyr::select(rank, feature, shap, value, pct, tgt_median),
             digits = c(0, 0, 4, 3, 1, 1),
             caption = paste0(GENE, ": top ", params$gene_top_n, " features by its own |SHAP|"))

if (params$save_plots) {
  out_csv <- file.path(O, sprintf("%s_geneshap_%s_%s.csv", OUT_STEM, CELL, GENE))
  write_csv(gene_res %>% mutate(split = gene_row$split), out_csv)
  cat("Saved", out_csv, "\n")
}
```

```{r figure-gene-shap, fig.width = 9, fig.height = fig_h(params$gene_top_n)}
gene_plot_df <- make_plot_df(gene_res)
p_gene <- base_plot(gene_plot_df,
                    paste0(GENE, ": its top features for eIF3d regulation in hypoxia, ",
                           CELL_LABEL, " transcriptome"),
                    paste0("Top ", params$gene_top_n, " features by ", GENE, "'s own SHAP in the ",
                           "MDA-MB-231 si3d hypoxia 1hr ", MODEL_DESC, ".\n", GENE, " was a ",
                           c(train = "training", test = "held-out")[[gene_row$split]], " gene. Green: ",
                           CELL_LABEL, " eIF3d targets (n = ", sum(is_target),
                           "); tick = median, bar = 25th-75th percentile."))
p_gene <- add_target_layers(p_gene, gene_plot_df, spread = TRUE)
p_gene

if (params$save_plots) {
  out <- here("plots", sprintf("%s_geneshap_%s_%s.pdf", OUT_STEM, CELL, GENE))
  ggsave(out, p_gene, width = 9, height = fig_h(params$gene_top_n))
  cat("Saved", out, "\n")
}
```
